**Jack Swigert** replaced Ken Mattingly as Apollo 13 command module pilot (areas/apollo-13.md; people/ken-mattingly.md). The change was decided at a KSC management meeting and announced at a press conference on 1970-04-10 (topics/rubella-crew-swap.md).

**Why:**
- Backup lunar module pilot Charlie Duke caught German measles and exposed the crews (topics/rubella-crew-swap.md).
- Blood tests from the 1970-04-06 physicals showed Mattingly had no rubella immunity (topics/rubella-crew-swap.md). He was the only one of the five prime and backup crew members tested who lacked rubella antibodies (people/ken-mattingly.md).
- Flight surgeon Charles Berry worried Mattingly could fall ill while alone in the command module in lunar orbit (topics/rubella-crew-swap.md).

Mattingly never contracted German measles. He later flew on Apollo 16 as command module pilot (people/ken-mattingly.md).
